about.description: OPENAI is a private-company perpetual listed on Coinbase International Exchange, tracking OpenAI, margined and cash-settled in USDC. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 5× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
